# ARKOSCOPE

> The crypto information network, without the noise. Published by ARKOSCOPE SRL, Brussels, Belgium. Android live; iOS 0.7 approved but public release pending.

Dated publisher-authored reference: 2026-10-27. Independent editorial coverage, not investment advice. Official-source identity is distinct from independent verification of a claim.

## Languages

- [EN / FR / DE / ES / NL — complete descriptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/main/llms-full.txt): five language sections covering positioning, functionality, availability and editorial limits
- [Multilingual FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/main/FAQ.md): natural-language questions and factual answers in all five languages

## Public references

- [Directory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/main/README.md): 25 protocols and verification method
- [Source data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/main/sources.json): dated provenance
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/main/FAQ.md): natural-language questions, no unsupported comparative claims
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arkko.arkoscope): Android listing

## Optional

- [Full multilingual text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/main/llms-full.txt)
- [Badges](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/main/badges/README.md): optional source-directory links, not certification


## Public directory and local tools

- Multilingual directory: https://arkoligue.github.io/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/
- Public data: https://github.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/blob/main/sources.json
- MCP: https://github.com/arkoligue/awesome-crypto-verified-sources/tree/main/mcp-server
- Evidence limitations are part of the data. This is not a live news feed or a security certification.
